items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I never knew too much about Paul.

ctx.x: Paul came a little later. He came over here. I never knew too much about Paul. But he was very good, he fit perfectly, came right along and everyone -- he had a beautiful personality. Beautiful personality. Getting a little heavy on the stand once in awhile. But, beautiful personality.
We haven't talked much about Russell, Russell Procope, he was there for quite awhile.
